subject.title: [Bug] Cron Job 使用错误的飞书账号发送消息 - 缺少 accountId 自动推断

question: Should omitted cron delivery account IDs prefer a configured agent/channel binding over session-derived `lastAccountId`, and should ambiguous binding/session cases fail closed?
rationale: This changes credential and tenant routing behavior for scheduled messages, so automation should not choose the permanent compatibility/security rule without maintainer intent.

options.title: Prefer binding after explicit account
options.body: Change cron delivery so explicit `delivery.accountId` wins, then a safe agent/channel binding wins over stale session account state, with ambiguity failing closed.

options.title: Keep session precedence
options.body: Document that cron delivery inherits session `lastAccountId` unless users set `--account`, preserving compatibility but leaving this wrong-account class to operator configuration.

options.title: Require explicit account in risky cases
options.body: Keep existing precedence for simple cases but make multi-account cron delivery without explicit account fail with an actionable error.

recommendation.title: Prefer binding after explicit account
recommendation.body: Change cron delivery so explicit `delivery.accountId` wins, then a safe agent/channel binding wins over stale session account state, with ambiguity failing closed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the binding-fallback behavior and is the strongest available owner for the account-precedence security choice.
